Prompt:
Consider a circle such that the radius [MATH: r] can vary. If [MATH: A] is the area of the circle, what is the best interpretation of [MATH: A^{′}(r)?]

Choices:
a. The circumference of the circle
b. The rate at which the area changes as the radius changes
c. The rate at which the radius changes as the area changes
d. The length of the radius of the circle
e. The area of a circle with radius [MATH: r]
